name: Nagan Maycraft
original_name: ナーガン・メイクラフト
source: Leicester's father and Shelley's husband. He used to be a famous adventurer, along with Fabious and Mise; he also seems to know Chelsea from that time. Former Temple Knight, currently is the manager of the Ert'Aria Cathedral. Can be frequently seen flirting with his wife.
